name: ManiaDrive
description:
ManiaDrive is an arcade car driving and acrobatic stunt game in the spirit of TrackMania. Built with realistic car physics, loop-the-loops, and death-defying jumps, it challenges players to beat track time records.

Features:
- Acrobatic stunt tracks with extreme loops, ramps, wall-rides, and chicanes
- Realistic vehicle dynamics and suspension physics powered by ODE
- Built-in 3D track editor enabling players to build and share custom stunt courses
- Energetic soundtrack featuring diverse licensed rock and electronic music
- Ghost car visualization to race against your personal best times
